headline.zh: 用纯黑色长方形当“自行车车架”，9 个基础标签草草收场
headline.en: A solid black rectangle stands in for a bike frame across just 9 SVG tags

spatialNotes.zh: 零 <path> 贝塞尔路径，仅靠 6 个圆、1 个黑矩形和 1 个小三角拼凑。两个 r=5 的实心小黑圆紧贴在矩形底部下方，完全没有机械结构概念。
spatialNotes.en: Zero <path> elements—just 6 circles, 1 black rectangle as the "frame," and a tiny orange triangle. An iconic Day-1 baseline showing how early LLMs coded blind.

headline.zh: 引入了渐变色和 <path>，但鹈鹕和车轮直接叠在了一起
headline.en: Introduced linear gradients and paths, yet bird and wheels collide awkwardly

spatialNotes.zh: 虽然写出了 body-gradient 和 beak-gradient 渐变定义，但通过 translate(100,150) 组合后，实心灰轮和曲线鸟身上下交叠，缺乏清晰的骑乘空间关系。
spatialNotes.en: Uses nice linear gradients and grouped <g> tags, but the solid grey wheels and blobby pelican geometry collide inside the coordinate group.

spatialNotes.en: A classic 2024 flagship artifact: proper hollow wheels and a frame triangle, topped by an upright snowman-like pelican whose short orange legs dangle in mid-air.

headline.en: Step-by-step code comments appear, though spatial proportions still lag

spatialNotes.zh: 源码注释出现了清晰的步骤拆解（Draw wheels → frame → handlebar → pedals），能画出脚踏雏形；但受限于早期训练分布，鹈鹕依旧呈垂直椭圆且缺少 viewBox。

headline.zh: 仅 2.4 KB 就用工程制图般的分块把车架各管件精确对齐
headline.en: Compact 2.4 KB blueprint explicitly naming seat tube, top tube, down tube & chainstay

spatialNotes.zh: 极具“理工科强迫症”风格的输出：用 ========== BICYCLE ========== 分区注释，依次计算立管、上管、下管和后下叉坐标，不再依赖盲猜。
spatialNotes.en: Reads like a CAD spec sheet: sectioned comments separate seat tube, top tube, down tube, and chainstay so every joint meets cleanly.
